description: Place many images as a contact sheet: an evenly spaced grid of frames, one file in each, fitted, flowing onto further pages as needed, optionally captioned (the place cursor's grid placing)

addPages.description: Add pages at the end when the files outrun the pages (otherwise stop and report the rest)

area.description: The area to fill on each page, mm from the page's top-left, with all four of x, y, width and height (default: inside the margins)

caption.description: Caption each image from its metadata (Caption Setup settings)

extensions.description: With folder: the extensions to take (default: jpg, jpeg, png, tif, tiff, psd, gif, bmp, pdf, ai, eps, svg, indd, heic, webp)

files.description: The files to place, in order

fit.description: How each image fits its cell

folder.description: Place every image in this folder instead (sorted by name)

name: place_contact_sheet
title: Place Contact Sheet
